pairs_v0_3.one_line: Breast cancer is the cancer EDEAR catches earliest in pre-diagnostic blood; prostate cancer is the cancer EDEAR sees the cleanest cell-of-origin signature in tumor tissue.
Lung and CRC share architectural class but diverge at the immune-compartment compartment-flip: lung drives systemic immune activation in pre-diagnostic blood, CRC drives systemic immune tolerance.
Tissue-arm effect size ordering d(lung) > d(CRC) > d(breast) > d(prostate) is consistent with tumor mutational burden ordering.
Both produce immune-class architectural drift readable in peripheral blood despite BBB cfDNA limitation. Different patterns, both Pathway 1.
Substrate-as-discriminator is HCC gift. Same disease class, different substrate gives different signal.
AD and PDAC are the cookbook two canonical Pattern 3 cases. Both teach: pooled-null does not mean biology-null.

pre_test_integrity_protocol_v0_3.rule: Before ANY interpretation downstream of Stage 1, the operator MUST verify the test passed all six data integrity checks, the biology consistency check, and the demographics stratification check.

CHK_3_1_raw_beta_distribution.rule: Real raw beta is bimodal: >30% at extremes (<0.1 or >0.9) AND <10% in middle (0.4-0.6)
failure_examples: VAL-077 GSE287994 cervical LBC: 50% middle 12% extremes
CHK_3_1_raw_beta_distribution.action_on_fail: STOP, reprocess from raw IDATs through minfi/sesame

CHK_3_1B_atlas_coverage_substrate_floor.rule: Per-sample atlas-CpG coverage threshold must match substrate floor, NOT default 95%
CHK_3_1B_atlas_coverage_substrate_floor.sealed_precedent: VAL-117 first execution failed at 0/210 samples on 95% threshold; amendment to 80% sealed before re-execution: 210/210 pass. CHK-2.8 cookbook-wide rule.

CHK_3_1C_atlas_duplicate_check.rule: Bridged atlases must be deduplicated; SHA-256 must be computed on bridged matrix and verified

CHK_3_2_cross_cohort_baseline_alignment.rule: Healthy mean A-score >1 SD from anchor = cross-cohort calibration failure, NOT disease finding
CHK_3_2_cross_cohort_baseline_alignment.sealed_precedent: VAL-100 polyp PNP- mean A_immune 0.807 vs Italian healthy anchor 0.438 = +15.13 anchor-SD offset
CHK_3_2_cross_cohort_baseline_alignment.action_on_fail: Use within-cohort paired comparison; do NOT interpret cases-vs-controls Cohen d in cross-cohort framing. CCL-034 secondary-evidence tier.

CHK_3_5_saturation_flag.rule: Each substrate has per-class A-ceiling; approaching ceiling produces saturation compression. Mandatory before any null outcome.

sample_group_assignment_spot_check.rule: Sample-title scan against published Methods BEFORE beta extraction; verify subgroup labels match cohort design
sample_group_assignment_spot_check.sealed_precedent: VAL-075 excluded mid-run because GSE38266 was HNSCC head/neck not cervical (cerv-LL-008)

biology_consistency_check_three_categori.transferability_finding: Clinical-grade panels achieve signal where framework reads null - panel does not transfer to specimen. Outcome: O5_TRANSFERABILITY_FLAG
biology_consistency_check_three_categori.cohort_heterogeneity_finding: Healthy reference is stratified by disease-relevant covariate - the disease has signal but comparator is wrong. Outcome: O5_COHORT_HETEROGENEITY_FLAG
biology_consistency_check_three_categori.true_biology_null: Clinical-grade panels also read null - true biology null at this resolution.

demographics_mandatory_stratifiers.age_regression_required: every Stage 1 analysis must report age-regressed A-score alongside raw A-score
demographics_mandatory_stratifiers.ancestry_mandatory_when: single-ancestry cohort OR ancestry-stratified disease incidence OR clinical-grade panels trained on different ancestry

CCL_006_cross_disease_direction_differen.rule: Different diseases drive same Xu-538 panel in different directions. Card specifies expected direction per disease.
CCL_006_cross_disease_direction_differen.cards_exhibiting: breast positive vs CRC negative on same panel

CCL_019_compartment_direction_flip.rule: A-score direction depends on (class, compartment) pair, not disease alone. Blood immune != tumor-infiltrating immune.

CCL_023_v0_2_orthogonal_not_inverted.rule: Cell-fraction direction (Bracci 2022 type) and A-score direction read orthogonal axes, not opposite.

CCL_027_mandatory_four_question_check.rule: Every card v0.1 must answer: (i) pooled-entropy expected direction; (ii) bidirectional-cancellation risk; (iii) directional-panel fallback specification; (iv) lymphoid-vs-myeloid expected pattern from literature.

CCL_028_pooled_null_directional_pass_mec.rule: When pooled nulls AND directional panel passes, mechanism unresolved between (a) lineage cancellation, (b) z-scoring sensitivity gain, (c) cohort/batch structure. Test 2 would distinguish.

CCL_030_per_cpg_delta_beta_descriptive_o.rule: Per-CpG cohort delta-beta direction percentage describes where beta shifted on average. NOT a mechanism diagnostic. 47/50/52% split is not bidirectional cancellation by itself.
CCL_030_per_cpg_delta_beta_descriptive_o.cards_exhibiting: all cards; cervical-epic VAL-073 canonical example

CCL_031_bidirectional_cancellation_termi.verbatim_single_sentence: Bidirectional cancellation is the AD-instance pattern: Test 1 pooled A_immune nulls cross-cohort AND a directional plus-or-minus 1 z-scored panel built on the same Stage 1 panel passes on holdout. Compartment-direction-flips, cross-disease direction differences, and negative-direction-dominant cohort-mean delta-beta are NOT bidirectional cancellation.

CCL_032_diagnostic_order_fixed.rule: Every cohort run with null or negative-direction reading must complete data integrity -> biology consistency -> framework finding in sequence BEFORE outcome drafted.
CCL_032_diagnostic_order_fixed.cards_exhibiting: all cards; cervical-epic VAL-076/077 canonical incident

CCL_039_cell_of_origin_tile_direction_de.rule: Tumor-vs-adjacent-normal paired comparisons: cell-of-origin tile NEGATIVE (homogenization). Diseased-tissue-vs-healthy-cross-reference: cell-of-origin tile POSITIVE. Prereg O1 must specify comparison type with magnitude-based |d| + direction labels.

ccl_031_five_pattern_taxonomy_v0_3.single_sentence_rule_verbatim: Bidirectional cancellation is the AD-instance pattern: Test 1 pooled A_immune nulls cross-cohort AND a directional plus-or-minus 1 z-scored panel built on the same Stage 1 panel passes on holdout.

AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.case: AD pooled A_immune AIBL n=726 d=+0.077 NULL (VAL-050). 7-CpG Rule A directional d=+0.624 (VAL-051). Cross-platform AddNeuroMed d=+0.33; age-adjusted residual d=+0.12 (VAL-052).
AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.doctrine: Pooled-entropy is not always sufficient. Directional weighting recovers signed signal when per-CpG direction is balanced bidirectional.
AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.card_consequence: Every Stage 1 design must answer CCL-027 question (iii).
AD_gift_pooled_vs_directional_distinctio.mechanism_caveat_ccl_028: AD directional recovery operationally robust but mechanistically unresolved. Three candidates: (a) lineage cancellation; (b) z-scoring sensitivity gain; (c) cohort/batch structure. Test 2 pending OQ-2026-01.

HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.case: HCC ccfDNA VAL-059 GSE298812 paired d=+0.6336 p=0.0024 sex-stratified male d=+0.998 female d=+0.497. HCC whole-blood VAL-059 GSE281691 controls=metabolic-liver-disease d=-0.1556 NULL.
HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.doctrine: Substrate choice IS part of the immune-class signature. For diseases of secretory organs that do not trigger massive systemic immune drift in healthy peripheral leukocytes, ccfDNA may be the right substrate even when whole-blood reads NULL.
HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.card_consequence: Future card builds must document substrate dichotomies as part of Stage 1 specification, not as failures.
HCC_gift_substrate_as_discriminator.bonus_finding_dose_response: Monotonic A-score progression healthy->fibrosis->cirrhosis->HCC (0.576->0.591->0.592->0.598). Signal scales with disease stage.

glioma_gift_orthogonal_vs_inverted_ccl_0.case: v0.1 predicted Stage 1 NEGATIVE per Bracci 2022 cell-fraction prior. VAL-088 read d=+0.91 POSITIVE. v0.1 sealed O5_POSITIVE_INVERTED. VAL-090 confirmed Bracci 2022 cell-fraction (neutrophils +16% lymphocytes -13%) AND cortical-neuron deconvolution d=+1.96.
glioma_gift_orthogonal_vs_inverted_ccl_0.doctrine: Cell-fraction direction and A-score direction are NOT opposite axes - they are orthogonal axes, different lenses on same disease state.
glioma_gift_orthogonal_vs_inverted_ccl_0.card_consequence: When a disease has both cell-fraction prior in literature AND Stage 1 A-score reading in framework, do NOT predict A-score direction from cell-fraction direction.

Bladder-epic v0.1 is the canonical reference example for the future-AI-2-years-from-now interpreter when EDEAR output exhibits structural patterns the immune-atlas card has not catalogued before. sixth_ccl_031_pattern.name: Pattern 6 — Substrate-distribution mismatch on mucosal cohort
sixth_ccl_031_pattern.definition: Two atlases score the SAME cell-of-origin question on the SAME paired pairs and produce HIGH-MAGNITUDE contrasts in OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS, not because of biology, but because the two atlas families measure different observables on the same substrate. Bulk-WGBS atlas families (Loyfer/Moss, Caggiano TIM) on mucosal-tissue cohorts produce inflated cross-tile A-scores from substrate-distribution mismatch. Gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas families (EpiSCORE per-tissue bridges) avoid this artifact.

canonical_case_sealed.chk_3_2_cross_tile_sanity: ALL 14 Loyfer non-bladder solid-tissue tiles fire POSITIVE +2.34 to +2.92 — uniform inflation confirms substrate-distribution mismatch

sixth_ccl_031_pattern.operational_rule: Multi-atlas readings on mucosal cohorts (bladder, lung airways, colon epithelium, GI epithelium, cervical mucosa) MUST include a gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas as the PRIMARY cell-of-origin reader. Single-atlas Stage 2 readings on mucosal cohorts using bulk-WGBS references can be substrate-substitution-fooled.

bladder_stage_3_sealed_signature_val_122._purpose: Stage 3 sub-cell-type signature for bladder cancer; canonical example of broad-positive multi-lineage immune-architectural drift

bladder_stage_3_sealed_signature_val_122.lineage_pattern: BROAD MULTI-LINEAGE POSITIVE — both lymphoid AND myeloid fire POSITIVE; pre-locked O2 (lymphoid-dominant Chen 2022 NMIBC blood RFS pattern) and O3 (myeloid-dominant MDSC pattern) did NOT fire
bladder_stage_3_sealed_signature_val_122.biological_interpretation: Mixed TIL+TAM+MDSC infiltration of muscle-invasive bladder tumor microenvironment
bladder_stage_3_sealed_signature_val_122.card_line_no_overclaim: Stage 3 immune fine-tune fires consistent with mixed TIL + TAM + MDSC infiltration in muscle-invasive bladder tumor microenvironment. All six Salas IDOL immune-cell-type A-scores increase in tumor vs adjacent-normal at |d_paired| range 0.49 to 1.24.

how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos._purpose: Operational guidance for the future-AI-2-years-from-now interpreter (corresponds to README §13.7)

pattern_signature.salas_idol: ALL 6 of 6 tiles fire POSITIVE at |d|>=0.30 with no NEGATIVE-firing tiles
pattern_signature.multi_atlas_convergence: pattern reproduces across UniLIFE 19-cell and Caggiano TIM immune subset

how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.underlying_biology: Mixed multi-lineage immune infiltration of a tissue compartment — TILs + tumor-associated macrophages + tumor-associated neutrophils + myeloid-derived suppressor cells + B lymphocytes (often in tertiary lymphoid structures) + NK cells. Standard immunology of muscle-invasive solid-tumor microenvironments under heavy infiltration.
how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.NOT_pathway_1_terminal_specimen_problem: Pathway 1 fires when Stage 1 immune is positive but Stage 2 cell-of-origin is null (e.g., glioma in plasma where 96% of cfDNA is non-brain). Bladder VAL-122 substrate IS the diseased tissue and Stage 2 BladderRef Epi fires NEGATIVE (CCL-039) — Stage 2 is NOT null. Pathway 1 does not apply.
how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.NOT_pathway_2_hematologic: Pathway 2 fires when disease IS the immune compartment (B-cell lymphoma, AML). Bladder VAL-122 is solid-tumor microenvironment infiltration, not immune-compartment-of-origin disease. Distinguishing test: does Stage 2 cell-of-origin tile fire at high magnitude with disease-appropriate direction? If yes (BladderRef Epi NEGATIVE), solid-tumor with infiltrate (NOT Pathway 2).
how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.NOT_pathway_3_cardiovascular_systemic: Pathway 3 fires when Stage 1 positive on whole-blood substrate but Stage 2 cell-of-origin null. Bladder VAL-122 is on tumor TISSUE substrate (not blood). If substrate=blood and Stage 2 null --> Pathway 3; if substrate=tumor tissue and Stage 2 BladderRef Epi NEGATIVE --> solid-tumor mixed-infiltration (THIS pattern, NOT Pathway 3).
how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.NOT_pathway_4_unexplained_drift: Pathway 4 applies to single Stage 1 positive at moderate magnitude with no Stage 2/3 corroboration; bladder VAL-122 has overwhelming Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 corroboration across 21 paired patients.

lymphoid_vs_myeloid_lineage_skew_test.myeloid_dominant_pattern: lymphoid (CD4T, CD8T, NK, Bcell) NEGATIVE + myeloid (Mono, Neu) POSITIVE — consistent with MDSC infiltration in advanced metastatic / immunotherapy-refractory disease
lymphoid_vs_myeloid_lineage_skew_test.lymphoid_dominant_pattern: myeloid (Mono, Neu) NEGATIVE + lymphoid (CD4T, CD8T) POSITIVE — consistent with Chen 2022 NMIBC blood RFS signature in early-stage / immunotherapy-responding disease
lymphoid_vs_myeloid_lineage_skew_test.broad_multi_lineage_pattern_THIS_IS_BLAD: BOTH lymphoid AND myeloid fire POSITIVE (no NEGATIVE-firing tiles in lineage panel) — heavily-infiltrated tumor microenvironment characteristic of muscle-invasive disease; NOT a clean lineage-skewed signature; do NOT report as lymphoid-dominant or myeloid-dominant
lymphoid_vs_myeloid_lineage_skew_test.suppressed_exhausted_pattern_HYPOTHETICA: BOTH lymphoid AND myeloid fire NEGATIVE — possible immune escape / late-stage tumor evasion / post-chemotherapy immune ablation; currently no sealed cookbook example

how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.is_stage_1_panel_reliable_check: When broad-positive Stage 3 fires alongside Stage 1 O4 panel-coverage gate fire (as in bladder-epic v0.1), the Stage 3 reading is independently informative. Salas IDOL + UniLIFE + Caggiano TIM are not gated by Stage 1 panel coverage. Stage 3 pattern stands on its own.
how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.is_bladderref_epi_negative_the_cell_of_o: Stage 2 cell-of-origin reading on a gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas should fire NEGATIVE per CCL-039 in tumor-vs-adjacent-normal paired comparisons. If BladderRef Epi or ProstateRef LE or future LungRef AT2 fires NEGATIVE alongside broad-positive Stage 3, this is the canonical solid-tumor mixed-infiltration cohort — generalizes to expected solid-tumor patterns for breast, lung, colon, cervical, GI cancers.
how_to_interpret_bladder_style_broad_pos.single_sentence_rule_for_this_pattern: When Stage 3 RUN-everything fires broad-positive across all six Salas IDOL tiles with no NEGATIVE-firing tiles, AND Stage 2 cell-of-origin fires NEGATIVE on the appropriate gene-promoter sub-cell-type atlas, AND Stage 2 microenvironment tiles fire POSITIVE, AND substrate is tumor tissue (not blood), the EDEAR output should be reported as: mixed multi-lineage immune infiltration of a solid-tumor microenvironment with cell-of-origin dedifferentiation, consistent with muscle-invasive / heavily-infiltrated cancer biology — NOT a lymphoid-skewed or myeloid-skewed signature.
